STEP 2. Check for open circuit, short circuit to ground and 
harness damage between data link connector C-29 
terminal 1 and ECM connector C-62 terminal 84 <M/T> or 
PCM connector C-59 terminal 84 <A/T>.
NOTE: Check harness after checking intermediate connectors 
C-77 and C-28. If intermediate connectors are damaged, repair 
or replace them. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness Connector 
Inspection (P.00E-2). Then check that the malfunction is 
eliminated.
Q: Is the harness wire in good condition?
YES :  Go to Step 3.
NO : Repair it. Then confirm that the malfunction symptom 
is eliminated.
STEP 3. Check for open circuit, short circuit to ground and 
harness damage between data link connector C-29 
terminal 7 and ECM connector C-62 terminal 85 <M/T> or 
PCM connector C-59 terminal 85 <A/T>.
NOTE: Check harness after checking intermediate connectors 
C-77 and C-28. If intermediate connectors are damaged, repair 
or replace them. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness Connector 
Inspection (P.00E-2). Then check that the malfunction is 
eliminated.
Q: Is the harness wire in good condition?
YES :  Refer to, INSPECTION PROCEDURE 29 − Power 
Supply System and Ignition Switch-IG System 
(P.13B-487).
NO : Repair it. Then confirm that the malfunction symptom 
is eliminated.
